description: AT Protocol importRepo: an account moving to this PDS loads its own repository.

main.description: Import a repo in the form of a CAR file. On this PDS only an account that is moving here and not yet activated may call it; the CAR must be signed by the DID's current atproto key and is fully verified before anything is stored. Replaces the account's repository. Exception (ADR-004): a self account that opened here with its rotation key may also import a CAR signed by the atproto key its DID named immediately before the PLC operation that points it here, when that operation was signed by the account's own first rotation key and is the latest one.

errors.name: InvalidCar
errors.description: CAR data is malformed or its root is not a repository commit.

errors.name: DidMismatch
errors.description: The CAR's commit belongs to a different DID.

errors.name: UnresolvableDid
errors.description: The DID's atproto signing key could not be resolved.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: The commit is not signed by the DID's current atproto key (nor, for a self account moving in with its rotation key, by the key the DID named just before its move here).

errors.name: InvalidRepo
errors.description: The repository is incomplete or malformed (missing blocks, broken record tree).

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: Request payload exceeds the accepted size limit.

errors.name: RepoRollback
errors.description: The repository being imported is older than the one already here.
